question: outcome_summary
answer: The implementation of the Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS) significantly improved the identification and documentation of suicide risk in pediatric outpatient behavioral health care. Completion rates of the C-SSRS in the electronic health record (EHR) ranged from 95.5% to 99.5%, indicating successful integration. The mean incidence of patients endorsing suicidal thoughts was 25%, with actual suicide attempts noted at 3%. The study highlights the tool's effectiveness in enhancing patient safety and clinical outcomes.
